[h1]TL:DR[/h1]
[i]Short period of time = spinoff of popular game plus its own quirks.[/i]

[h1]The Good Stuff[/h1]
++Fine leather jackets
+Good humor, and the references to other games are done in good taste
+Short adventure with some dialog options and corky characters
+Takes many shots at the AAA industry of games *cough* EA *cough*
+Art design is great for having only 24 or 48 hours in a contest (I forget how long they had)
+DLC is to support the Devs for their work. They state this so at least they're honest about it *cough* EA *sneeze*

[h1]The Ok Stuff[/h1]
=The DLC is cosmetic :p

[h1]The Bad Stuff[/h1]
-Nothing. Can't say much considering they had such a short time.
